changes: Installed Home: first Back preserves document/audio and shows a prompt; a second within 800 ms permits native browser exit. Routes and overlays retain priority.
Exit protection rearms after return, expired holds, visibility changes and BFCache restoration; BFCache app path has unit coverage, not a physical mobile claim.
Visual keyboard occlusion controls the bottom dock while focus-only, pinch zoom and small height changes remain excluded.

Canonical edited YouTube metadata survives stale queue consumers, likes, history, playlists and saved downloads without refetching saved audio. Resuming the current ID keeps its queue copy, matching APK; fresh collection playback uses current library metadata.
A failed download transfer can renew its source once with bounded retry and preserved cancellation/rollback.
Total RSS failure with requested-language candidates surfaces an error and retry; genuine empty results and partial results remain distinct.

staticAndBuildChecks.nativeFrontendScope: Native frontend build passed after shared changes; final lifecycle fixes and subsequent runner edits affect only web navigation/tests.

browser.scope: Rows are actual executed checks, including grouped actions. A failed grouped check does not prove later actions ran. Browser layout emulation, synthetic providers, virtual clocks and DOM gestures do not verify physical operating systems or cars.

browserUIBack.scope: Desktop browser keyboard accelerator control remains separate from History API traversal and physical Android Back.

standalone.forwardAppObservation: New document load observed on app Forward; external control restoration used BFCache. App BFCache rearm is covered by unit tests.
standalone.scope: Desktop Chrome app mode and normal-browser control, real Audio/History API; no Android system Back/Home/minimize claim.

update.scope: Real service worker, IndexedDB and CacheStorage. Independent legacy migration uses a fresh disposable Chrome process with the same version/options, without prior ServiceWorker CDP or receiver instrumentation. Seeded WAV validates persistence and route bytes, not provider audio playback.

publication.liveScope: Desktop Chrome with live providers and decoder progress; no physical speaker or phone verification.

preservedControls.explanation: Original failures and diagnostics are preserved with their own builds and counts. Old same-ID mini-player expectation was corrected to match APK. Reusing one QA Chrome process stalled skipWaiting; isolation was observed to remove it without identifying the internal mechanism. Earlier red runs are not counted as final passes.
